emus.definition: n. any of various systems of units for measuring electricity and magnetism\nn. large Australian flightless bird similar to the ostrich but smaller
emus.translation: n. 鸸鹋（产于澳洲的一种体型大而不会飞的鸟）( emu的复数形式 )

emy.translation: abbr. Emilia 伊米莉亚; Emily 艾米丽
